articles.title: パナソニック コネクト、大変革の本丸「人事」何をどう変えたのか - ニュース・経営
articles.summary: 日本の伝統的な大企業グループの中にあって、この4年で売上を1.5倍近く、営業利益を6倍以上に伸ばしたパナソニック コネクト。パナソニックホールディングスを構成する主要企業の1社で、主にBtoBビジネスを展開する。この変革を支える取り組みの一つが、ジョブ型人事制度や対話重視のマネジメントへの移行など、先進的な「新人材マネジメント」の導入だ。何をどう変えたのか。『パナソニック コネクト　大企業をいかに変えるか』（日経BP）の著者、上阪徹氏がキーマンの一人である新家伸浩執行役員CHROに聞いた。

articles.title: ボスも給与競争もない職場は成立する？全員同一時給のデンマーク協同組合Analyse & Talが示す答え
articles.summary:

articles.title: 民主主義を望む声が、「本当に求めるもの」は何なのか
articles.summary:

articles.title: 病気、老い──人間が安心して弱くなれるために。デンマークの家具アクティビストが提示する「尊厳のデザイン」
articles.summary:

articles.title: Common supplements rival antibiotics for severe gum disease
articles.summary: Omega-3 and low-dose aspirin matched the effectiveness of antibiotics in a year-long study of patients with severe gum disease, with both approaches helping about 58% reach the treatment goal. articles.title: Your waist size may reveal health risks BMI misses
articles.summary: A simple waist measurement may be nearly as effective as more complicated methods for detecting unhealthy levels of body fat. Researchers also found that BMI alone missed many people with obesity, suggesting waist size could provide an important warning sign.

articles.summary: Weapons buried with ancient Egyptian princesses may have been more than ceremonial decorations. articles.title: Seven new frog species were hiding beneath Madagascar’s forest floor

articles.summary: Dogs and humans may have more in common when it comes to aging than scientists realized. articles.title: A common vape flavoring may disrupt early embryo development
articles.summary: A popular vanilla flavoring in e-cigarettes may interfere with some of the earliest steps of human development. In lab experiments, vanillin caused embryonic stem cells to lose their ability to develop normally and pushed them toward forming only certain types of tissue.

articles.summary: Ancient teeth and human DNA are revealing a surprising history of insect eating. articles.title: Vitamin C won’t prevent most colds, but it may do one small thing
articles.summary: The belief that huge doses of vitamin C can ward off colds was popularized more than 50 years ago by Nobel Prize winner Linus Pauling. articles.title: Why scientists asked 1,000 people to bury their underwear
articles.summary: More than 1,000 volunteers buried cotton underwear across Switzerland to help scientists measure how active different soils are. articles.title: Smart nanoparticles light up brain cancer and destroy what surgery misses
articles.summary: Scientists created smart nanoparticles that can both illuminate hidden glioblastoma cells during surgery and destroy microscopic cancer left behind afterward. In mice, the treatment prevented recurrence and led to 100% survival at 60 days, though it has not yet been tested in humans.

articles.title: Claude Codeの週間上限、9月14日から25%増。現状比では17%減に
articles.summary: Anthropicは8月30日(米国時間)、X(旧Twitter)の@ClaudeDevsアカウントにおいて、開発者向けAIコーディングツール「Claude Code」の有料プラン向けに設定されている標準的な週あたりの利用上限枠を、9月14日より恒久的に25%引き上げると発表した。対象となるのは、Pro、Max、Team、およびシートベースのEnterpriseプラン。
